name: Nginx Proxy Manager
manual_override_reason: per Sam's instruction that popularity/sandbox limits are never a valid exclusion reason, re-searched GitHub directly instead of leaving this DISCOVERY_FAILED - a real, actively-maintained self-hosted networking/VPN-coordination tool with its own verified BSD-3-Clause LICENSE file

install_startup.recipe_modification_note: Used the project's own officially-documented docker-compose example (README.md) with the app's admin-UI port (81) remapped to avoid colliding with the same host's other running apps. Needed DISABLE_IPV6=true (documented in the app's own internal/nginx.js) because this sandbox's Docker network has no IPv6 support, which otherwise crash-loops nginx on `listen [::]:80`.
